console_capture.description: Daemon opt-in for extension-side CDP console capture. Absent (the default) keeps capture off: attaching to a tab never sends `Runtime.enable` / `Log.enable`. Some daemons run `on` to restore buffered console capture for `tool.console`.

cursor_overlay.description: Daemon opt-in for the extension's on-page visual cursor indicator. Present (`true`) when the daemon was started with the overlay enabled (the default); absent when the operator disabled it, so the extension keeps pages free of the indicator nodes.

min_compatible_peer.description: **Deprecated** — legacy app-semver floor. New peers should use `min_compatible_protocol`; this field is optional and ignored.

min_compatible_protocol.description: Lowest peer protocol version this daemon accepts.
